name: Sharon Jefferson

items.why: The item says no foreign-government payments, foreign-agent donors or similar ties were documented, so there is no conduct to weigh under the foreign-ties criterion.

for_review: The searches found no reporting tying Jefferson to foreign money, and nothing from the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up. The one reported campaign-finance detail is that all her contributions were individual gifts of $200 or less, about $3,700 as of July 2026. Reports from Nov 3-4, 2026 say she won the runoff against incumbent Cindy Spray. Before that she was a teacher and candidate, so she has not yet held the seat and has no board record. A Bradenton Times piece describes dark-money attack mailers against her, but that is about others' conduct, not hers, and I left it out. I did not open the FARA database or the state campaign-finance database directly.
